title: Witness admits seeing up to 60 ‘maleta’ at Zaldy Co’s condo

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A prosecution witness told the Sandiganbayan Third Division on Monday that he saw up to 60 “maleta” moved in and out of the luxury condominium of former Ako Bicol Rep. Zaldy Co, and was told by colleagues that it contained cash. Maj. Alvin Nuguid, who served as close-in security of Co, made this testimony as he took the witness stand to testify on the plunder bail hearing of former Speaker Martin Romualdez stemming from alleged P7.44-billion kickbacks from infrastructure projects.
